title: Professional Email Terms: Cancellation and Refunds
content:
**Clause 1. Who cancels.** Only the customer can cancel a Professional Email subscription, either immediately or by turning renewal off so the subscription ends at the term end; a subscription whose renewal has been turned off stands cancel pending. A scheduled cancellation may be withdrawn before the term end date, and the subscription is then active with renewal on. A term that ends unrenewed leaves the subscription expired, with mail readable for the product's expired grace days.

**Clause 2. Refund window.** An immediate cancellation of an annual term is refunded only before the start of the current annual term plus the product's cancellation window hours, counted as elapsed hours. The hours are counted in full 60-minute periods from 00:00 on the term start date, and reaching the last hour closes the window. The term start date is read from the subscription record.

**Clause 3. Refund amount.** Inside the window the term's charges are refunded in full where the product's refund basis is full, or by the unused calendar days of the term over its calendar days where it is prorated daily, rounded half up to the cent. The unused days are the calendar days from today to the term end date; the term's calendar days run from the term start date to the term end date.

**Clause 4. Outside the window.**

> Former clause, no longer in force: outside the window an immediate cancellation ends the subscription without any refund, and a month-to-month charge is never refunded.

Clause now in force: outside the window an immediate cancellation ends the subscription without any refund, and a month-to-month charge is never refunded, its unused days being credited only against an annual conversion as the annual conversion's own rule states.

**Clause 5. Where a refund goes.** A refund goes to the original payment method, or to account credit where the customer elects it or the charge was paid from credit.

## Window boundary (hypothetical 720-hour window)

| Moment of the immediate cancellation | Elapsed hours | Refund |
|---|---|---|
| 23:00 on the 29th calendar day after the term start date | 719 | inside the window |
| 00:00 on the 30th calendar day after the term start date | 720 | none: the window is closed |

## Worked example (hypothetical charge)

An annual charge of 1200.00 on a product whose refund basis is prorated daily, cancelled inside the window with 300 unused days in a 365-day term: 1200.00 times 300 divided by 365 is 986.3013..., refunded as 986.30.

superseded_clauses: Outside the window an immediate cancellation ends the subscription without any refund, and a month-to-month charge is never refunded (monthly_plan_refundable).
